about_the_game:
Explore the vast ocean, survive deadly encounters, and uncover the secrets of a lost island.

Roam in a Deadly Sea.

The ocean is more than just a path—it's a predator of its own. Stranded and vulnerable, you'll navigate across rough waters with nothing but instinct to guide you. Beneath the surface, shadows move. Strange shapes glide past the boat. The sea is full of life, but not all of it wants you alive. Survive the chaos, stay afloat, and find your way to the island—if the sea allows it.

A Helicopter, A Hope, A New Hell.

Just when all hope seems lost in the open ocean, the sound of rotor blades breaks through the silence. A helicopter appears, cutting through the stormy sky, and pulls you from the deadly sea below. But the relief is short-lived. As you rise above the waves, the horizon reveals something unexpected—a remote island untouched by time. You’ve escaped the sea… only to be dropped into something far more dangerous.

Arrival on the Island.

The roar of the helicopter fades, replaced by the eerie silence of the island. No signs of civilization. No welcome. Just dense jungle, scattered ruins, and a strange tension in the air. Nature here feels... wrong—too still, too alive. Forest was not moving with wind but with breath. Every step forward brings new unease as you realize this place is untouched by time. The deeper you go, the clearer it becomes: this island hides something ancient. Something massive. Something that should’ve never survived.

Escape from the Island.

Just as you think you've escaped, the sea reveals its true danger. Something in the depths is following, determined to drag you back. No matter how fast you go, it’s getting closer. The water churns violently as it closes in, and you realize—getting away from the island is only the beginning. The sea won't let you go so easily.

content_descriptors.notes: Blood, gore and killing of dinosaurs.

name: UNEXTINCTION

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-10100F or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2050 or AMD Radeon RX 6500 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit / Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12400F or AMD Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 or AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12

short_description: A thrilling adventure where you explore a forgotten island, encounter dangerous animals, and try to escape the terrifying dangers lurking in the ocean. As you flee, something unstoppable emerges from the depths, determined to drag you back into the dark waters.
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian
*languages with full audio support
